paragraphs: InvoiceCloud sells a digital billing and payments platform to organizations that bill customers directly. Utilities are one target market, with the offering framed around modern digital billing for utility customers. Public agencies are another, alongside a version aimed at making tax payments easier for constituents.

Payers get online and mobile options including one-click checkout, scheduled payments and secure paperless billing. Customizable reminders go out across email, text and voice notifications to reduce late or missed payments. The platform connects to more than 160 existing customer information systems. It runs as a cloud service with automated upgrades, enterprise-grade security and instant access to new features. The company also markets AI embedded in billing and payment workflows to identify exceptions.

Client quotes on the site are attributed to a customer services manager at Sacramento Suburban Water District. Another is attributed to a collections supervisor at New Hanover County. The operating company behind the brand is Invoice Cloud, Inc.

quote.text: Less process management, more meaningful results.
